Beijing Municipal Archives: "Jingzhang Luguang Sheying" (京张路工撮影), the 1909 official photo archive of the Jingzhang Railway construction and opening ceremony (178 photos) - primary archival source for the 1909 history narrative.

People's Daily Online "On This Day": Jingzhang Railway opened to traffic on 1909-09-24; key facts: 1905-09-04 start at Liucun bridge, 1909-08-11 completion, 1909-10-02 Nankou ceremony, 201.2 km, max grade 33 per-mille, herringbone zigzag at Qinglongqiao, 693 wan tael cost.

China News Service "A Century-Long Leap of the Jingzhang Railway" (2019-09-23, 110th anniversary): Zhan Tianyou as chief engineer, herringbone line and double-locomotive traction, vertical-shaft tunnelling method, Qinglongqiao station history.
